summary: AppSettings is a ready-made MountainAshBaseSettings subclass for application-level configuration. It pre-declares common fields: LOCALE_TIMEZONE, DEBUG, RUNDATE, RUNTIME, RUNDATETIME. Intended as a convenience base for user applications — subclass AppSettings instead of MountainAshBaseSettings for opinionated defaults.
extension_points: post_init(): override to add application-specific derived fields
lifecycle_notes: RUNDATE and RUNTIME are set to datetime.now() at class definition time — instances created at different times will share the same date unless post_init re-evaluates
RUNDATETIME is derived in post_init from RUNDATE and RUNTIME
risks: RUNDATE/RUNTIME Field defaults capture time at class import — not at instance creation. Long-running processes may produce stale timestamps.
